title: Alien propulsion via electromagnetic energy and time

tellings.quote: the um it had to do with electromagnetic energy and and time.

plain: Alien craft move using electromagnetic energy and time, according to a former sergeant named Dan Sherman, who says the NSA hired him in the early 1990s to communicate with aliens and that this is what he learned while doing it, at a place he calls Base 2. He tells Michels this in connection with Bob Lazar, a man who says he worked on alien craft at a secret site in Nevada, and if true it would mean the craft work on a principle that goes beyond ordinary engines.
